headline: Columbus State go unbeaten in conference play
dek: Columbus State came through conference play without a defeat, the only side in the table to do so. North Georgia, the one side to score more goals, lost to them in September and again in November.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring has split the conference in two: North Georgia alone have more goals than Georgia College and Clayton State together, and the two biggest attacks belong to the two sides at the top of the table.

wire.line: North Georgia have outscored every other side in the conference and still could not beat Columbus State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches are past their dates with no result published, and every one of them is dated in August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eighteen different players have scored for Columbus State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Grace McGill has set up as many goals as she has scored for North Georgia, eleven of each.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hollie Keefe has made 121 saves for Middle Georgia State, and 41 shots have still beaten her.

last_match.line: Flagler are the only other conference side to have beaten North Georgia.

next_match.line: Columbus State have not lost to a conference side; Flagler held them to a draw in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
